Name: Display Hotkeys
Author: Lee Cleobury
Description: Save monitor layouts (which displays are on, resolution, refresh rate, position, rotation, HDR and scaling) and switch between them from a key or from a keyboard hotkey anywhere in Windows.

Actions.Name: Switch Display Profile
Actions.Tooltip: Switch to a saved display layout. Can also be given a keyboard hotkey.

Actions.Name: Cycle Display Profiles
Actions.Tooltip: Step through every saved display layout in turn. Can also be given a keyboard hotkey.
